articles.title: 2026-10-28, Version 26.13.0 'Lithium' (LTS), @richardlau
articles.summary: Notable Changes This release marks the transition of Node.js 26.x into Long Term Support (LTS) with the codename 'Lithium'. It will continue to receive updates through to the end of April 2029. Other than updating metadata, such as the process.release object, to reflect that the release is LTS, no further changes from Node.js 26.12.1 are included.
